title: Ban cap nhat v1.8.3 - Tu dong bam dong popup Upload a Profile Photo (nut X / Not Now)
releaseNotes:
- Tu dong nhan dien va bam nut X (Close) hoac 'Not Now' tren popup 'Upload a Profile Photo' khi vua vao Profile de truy cap vao Settings muot ma khong bi chan
